lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the 5th gill slit, with the highest intensity nodes concentrated along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of rectangular grid nodes across the mid-lateral flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the first dorsal fin silhouette, with a higher concentration observed towards the leading edge compared to the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of a remora (Echeneidae) swimming in close proximity to the ventral region near the pectoral fin base.
